languages.scheduling_priority: select verified story and audience; then choose earliest eligible post window, no quota-filling

scheduling.scanner: once per hour at approximately HH:11 local; no extra scheduled task
scheduling.publish_at_rule: publish due now on a commit-triggered job within a preferred audience window; never prequeue a future-dated job solely to target a precise minute while the GitHub queue recovery remains every six hours
scheduling.breaking_news: score >= 90: first policy-valid time, including outside preferred windows
scheduling.off_peak_scans: lightweight triage unless a genuine breaking/exceptional story appears
scheduling.weekend_scans: same hourly frequency but fewer routine posts; breaking news unaffected
scheduling.source_validation: at least two independent reliable references and rights-cleared media or generated editorial JPEG
scheduling.experimental_evening: limited evidence-gathering only, not default volume
